name: Custom Effects
description: Displays weather and decorative effects on Gnuboard7 pages.

settings.title: Custom Effects Settings
settings.description: Configure the weather effect, density, and where it runs.
settings.notice: Refresh a visitor page after saving to apply your changes.

enabled.label: Enable effects
enabled.hint: Displays the selected weather effect on visitor pages.

effect.label: Effect
effect.hint: Choose a weather or decorative effect.

intensity.label: Effect density (%)
intensity.hint: Choose a particle density from 10 to 200.

speed.label: Fall speed (%)
speed.hint: Choose a percentage of the default speed from 25 to 300.

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: Controls how strongly particles move in the selected direction.

wind_direction.label: Wind direction
wind_direction.hint: Choose no wind, left, right, or a random direction per particle.

color.label: Particle color
color.hint: Choose one of the preset sample colors.

schedule_enabled.label: Enable scheduling
schedule_enabled.hint: When scheduling is on, only a matching schedule effect is shown. Times use the site default timezone.

schedules.empty: No schedules yet. Add a schedule to begin.

schedule_start_date.label: Start date
schedule_start_date.hint: Leave empty for no start-date limit.

schedule_end_date.label: End date
schedule_end_date.hint: The entire end date is included.

schedule_start_time.label: Daily start time
schedule_start_time.hint: Leave empty to start at the beginning of the day.

schedule_end_time.label: Daily end time
schedule_end_time.hint: An earlier end time is treated as ending the next day.

schedule_timezone.label: Timezone
schedule_timezone.hint: Scheduled times use the site default timezone.

mobile_enabled.label: Enable on mobile
mobile_enabled.hint: Disabled by default on mobile to reduce battery usage.

admin_enabled.label: Enable in admin
admin_enabled.hint: Disabled by default to avoid distracting from administration.

respect_reduced_motion.label: Respect reduced motion
respect_reduced_motion.hint: Hides effects for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
